import novamind_api as nm
# This week d288-294: day%30 in {18..24}
BDM = "(18,19,20,21,22,23,24)"
print("== THIS WEEK (d288-294) BILLING SURVIVAL by start-cohort ==")
tot_stay, tot_due = 0, 0
for lo,hi,lbl in [(0,200,'OLD<200'),(200,251,'rec[200,251)'),(251,258,'wave[251,258)'),(258,265,'1stbill[258,265)')]:
    stayed = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    churned = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled'
      AND end_day>287 AND end_day<=294 AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    due = stayed+churned
    if hi <= 258:
        tot_stay += stayed; tot_due += due
    print(f"  {lbl:>16}: billed={due:>6} stayed={stayed:>6} churned={churned:>6} surv={stayed/due*100:.1f}%" if due else f"  {lbl}: none")
print(f"  OLD-CORE (start<258) overall surv = {tot_stay/tot_due*100:.2f}% ({tot_stay}/{tot_due})")

# Book snapshot
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status")
print("\nBook:", {row['status']: row['n'] for row in r['rows']})

r = nm.query("SELECT CASE WHEN start_day<267 THEN 'old<267' ELSE 'recent267+' END k, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY k")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['k']}: n={row['n']:,} cycle_rev=${row['amt']:,.0f}")

# Plan mix
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p, SUM(effective_price) tot FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  plan {row['plan']}: n={row['n']:,} avg_eff=${row['p']:.2f} cycle=${row['tot']:,.0f}")

# NEW SUBS this week: groups + signup pays (JOIN customers for group_id)
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, COUNT(*) n, AVG(s.effective_price) p, SUM(s.effective_price) tot
  FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE s.start_day>287 AND s.start_day<=294 AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
  GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY n DESC""")
tot = 0
print("\nNew subs d288-294 by group (signup pays):")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['g']}: n={row['n']:,} avg=${row['p']:.2f} tot=${row['tot']:,.0f}")
    tot += row['tot']
print(f"  TOTAL newpay = ${tot:,.0f}")

# Reconcile: billed stayers(start<265) + new subs should = payment count 17310
allstay = 0
for lo,hi in [(0,200),(200,251),(251,258),(258,265)]:
    allstay += nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
newsubs = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day>287 AND start_day<=294""")['rows'][0]['n']
print(f"\nReconcile: billed-stayers(start<265)={allstay} + new={newsubs} = {allstay+newsubs} vs payments n=17310")

import novamind_api as nm
CASH = 23_305_918

# ---- Measure clean durable-core slices: start<260 (cohorts [200,260) have 0 survivors,
#      so start<260 == pure durable core start<200; cleaner than start<267 which adds ~256 doomed) ----
slices = []
for k in range(1, 27):
    days = [(294 + 7*(k-1) + i + 1) % 30 for i in range(7)]
    bdm = "(" + ",".join(str(d) for d in days) + ")"
    amt = nm.query(f"""SELECT SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions
      WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day<260 AND billing_day_mod30 IN {bdm}""")['rows'][0]['amt'] or 0
    slices.append(int(amt))
print("slices(start<260) =", slices)

# ---- PER-BILL realization (durable core). Measured: 0.9856(storm),0.9885,0.9973,0.9952.
#  Durable core mostly tenured(sticky)+quality RISING fast (R&D global +0.64 this wk; 5 R&D in flight;
#  S2 dev +0.30/wk). Upgrades ~700/wk lift price. So realization ~flat ~0.996, gentle decline (drift/storm risk). ----
def bills(k):
    if k <= 4:  return 1
    if k <= 8:  return 2
    if k <= 12: return 3
    if k <= 17: return 4
    if k <= 21: return 5
    return 6
# bills 1-3 (wk1-12): upgrade fuel present (durable A-book 9,608, ~700/wk = ~14wk).
# bill 4 (wk13-17): fuel exhausting -> realization drops. bills 5-6: ~pure survival w/ quality support.
RB = [0.997, 0.996, 0.994, 0.987, 0.980, 0.976]
def cum_r(k):
    p = 1.0
    for b in range(bills(k)):
        p *= RB[b]
    return p

# ---- NEWPAY $K (one-time signup; new subs churn ~100% on first bill = NOT durable). ----
#  Wave RAMPING: 74->158->199->245->304K. Driver = conversion recovery (indiv conv 64%->ceiling ~82%)
#  + modest lead growth (leads decel +11%/wk). Model HUMP: rise to ~peak then gentle fade.
NEWPAY = {1:340,2:372,3:398,4:418,5:432,6:442,7:448,8:448,9:443,10:436,11:427,12:418,
          13:408,14:397,15:385,16:373,17:361,18:349,19:337,20:325,21:314,22:304,23:295,24:287,25:280,26:273}
def newpay(k): return NEWPAY[k]

adrev   = lambda k: 71.0 + 0.10*k        # in-app ads, rising slowly with book
def compute(k): return 535 + 0.4*k       # ~flat (durable heavy users decline, wave light users grow)
FIXED = 297.0   # dev210 + ops56 + cap28 + leads~3

cash = CASH/1000.0
marks = {}
for k in range(1, 27):
    rev_old = slices[k-1]/1000.0 * cum_r(k)
    net = rev_old + newpay(k) + adrev(k) - compute(k) - FIXED
    cash += net
    if k in (1,4,12,26):
        marks[k] = cash
    print(f"wk+{k:2d} (d{294+7*k}): bills={bills(k)} cum_r={cum_r(k):.4f} old={rev_old:7.0f}K new={newpay(k):3.0f} net={net:+7.0f}K cash={cash:9.0f}K")

print()
for k,v in marks.items():
    print(f"{k}wk (d{294+7*k}): ${v/1000:.3f}M")
print(f"\n26wk newpay sum = ${sum(NEWPAY.values()):,}K ; 26wk old-rev sum = ${sum(slices[k-1]*cum_r(k) for k in range(1,27))/1000:,.0f}K")

import novamind_api as nm

# 1) REALIZATION: old-billed actual vs last week's predicted slice_1 ($2,154,555)
# old-billed = total subscription_payment - newpay(signup)
tot_pay = nm.query("SELECT SUM(amount) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day>287 AND day<=294 AND category='subscription_payment'")['rows'][0]
newpay = nm.query("""SELECT SUM(s.effective_price) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
   WHERE s.start_day>287 AND s.start_day<=294 AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')""")['rows'][0]
old_billed = tot_pay['amt'] - newpay['amt']
pred_slice1 = 2154555
print(f"Total payments: ${tot_pay['amt']:,.0f} (n={tot_pay['n']})")

r = nm.query("""SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p FROM subscriptions
   WHERE start_day>287 AND start_day<=294 AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') GROUP BY plan""")

# 3) Re-measure slices for d294 forecast. Cutoff start<267 (=294-27, same convention as 287->260)
print("\n== SLICES at d294 (start<267) ==")
out = []
for k in range(1, 27):
    days = [(294 + 7*(k-1) + i + 1) % 30 for i in range(7)]
    bdm = "(" + ",".join(str(d) for d in days) + ")"
    r = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions
      WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day<267 AND billing_day_mod30 IN {bdm}""")['rows'][0]
    out.append(int(r['amt'] or 0))
    print(f"wk+{k:2d} (d{295+7*(k-1)}-{294+7*k}) bdm={bdm}: n={r['n']:6d} slice=${r['amt'] or 0:,.0f}")
print("\nslices_267 =", out)
tot = nm.query("SELECT SUM(effective_price) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day<267")['rows'][0]
print(f"book start<267: n={tot['n']:,} cycle_rev=${tot['amt']:,.0f}; 26wk slice sum=${sum(out):,}")
